newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - CNPC (Hong Kong) rated buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CNPC (Hong Kong) rated buy.

text.p: Deutsche Morgan Grenfell has initiated coverage of red chip CNPC (Hong Kong) Ltd with a speculative buy and an overweight recommendation, the company said in a report issued recently.
"CNPC (Hong Kong), a seed-corn red chip, is set to quadruple in size over the next two years via favourably structured asset injects," said analyst Fanton Chuck.
Its parent, China National Petroleum Corp (CNPC), is China's onshore petroleum monopolist and owns 91 percent of China's total petroleum reserves worth more than US$100 billion, Chuck said.
"Near term, CNPC (Hong Kong) will probably receive only proven producing fields with minimal technical risks," the report said.
These are not strictly asset acquisitions, but the granting of the right to invest in or develop oilfields via the signing of production sharing contracts, it said.
Chuck is forecasting earnings of HK$98 million in 1997 and HK$528 million in 1998.
The share gained HK$0.09 to close at HK$1.73 on Monday.
